Welcome! I am a visiting professor in quantitative methods at the Department of Social Sciences at the University Carlos III of Madrid. Previously, I was a postdoctoral researcher at Witten/Herdecke University and a PhD candidate at Aarhus University.
My research interests include representation, electoral systems, party politics, and political violence. Methodologically, I am interested in causal inference and quantitative text analysis. 
You can contact me at eaviganoac@gmail.com. My CV can be downloaded here.

title: Teaching
text:
I have experience teaching courses both at the bachelor and master’s level at Aarhus University, Heinrich Heine University, University of Milan, and University Carlos III of Madrid.

Research methods (BA course, Madrid; course convenor and lecturer), 2025/2026.
Public Policy Evaluation (BA course, Madrid; lecturer), 2025/2026.
Political Analysis (BA course, Madrid; course convenor and lecturer), 2025/2026.
Positive Political Theory (MSc course, Milan; teaching assistant), 2024/2025.
Electoral Systems and Representation (BA course, HHU; course convenor and lecturer), 2024/2025.
Electoral Systems: Do They Really Matter? (MA course, Aarhus; course convenor and lecturer), 2022/2023. Syllabus.
Political Institutions: Western Countries, EU, and Foreign Policy (Aarhus, teaching assistant), 2021/2022
